facts.fact: The Civil Service Agency and the National Identification Registry signed an MoU on 27 May 2024 giving the CSA ongoing access to the NIR's e-verification platform, which the NIR's executive director says can run individual and batch verifications.

LBR.note: The document says nothing on links between the civil register and the ID system.
The document names no finance, revenue or payroll system in use, only payroll verification against the NIR.
No enrolment count or share is given.
Nothing on numbers given at birth.
Nothing on who operates, maintains or owns the ID system.

facts.fact: The CSA and NIR agreed on 27 May 2024 to put National Identification Numbers on the civil-service ID cards for all 103 government spending entities and to use NIR verification to clean up the government payroll.

The document describes the National Identification Registry as holding unique National Identification Numbers and running an e-verification platform, with the 27 May 2024 MoU to issue biometric cards carrying the NIN to civil servants.
